treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Child newly diagnosed, i.e., within 16 weeks (112 days) from time of diagnosis of cancer not including the day of diagnosis, OR

coder_notes: Behavioural communication intervention for parents of children with high-risk cancer; no drug or biologic. Phase NA and CHILD-only in registry (fails S3/S4 by code). Comparator arm already typed ACTIVE_COMPARATOR.
